deliverables.description: Supporting source code for the web application or web site, including front-end and back-end logic, markup, styling, and scripting needed to fulfill the specified functional and interface requirements.

information_nodes.description: Specification of the web application or web site features, pages, and behaviors that the supporting code must implement.
Any existing project source code, templates, or modules that the new supporting code must integrate with or extend.
Design or interface specification describing layout, components, and interaction patterns the code should support.
Analyze the project requirements and any existing code or design specifications to determine the appropriate technologies, code structure, and integration points for the supporting code.
Write the supporting code—markup, styling, scripting, and any server-side logic—needed to implement the specified web application or web site features and behaviors.

work_objective: Write supporting code for a web application or web site, implementing the functional and interface requirements specified for the project.

deliverables.description: An edited video sequence assembling the selected shots from each scene into a continuous, logically ordered narrative.

information_nodes.description: All available raw video recordings of each scene, including multiple takes and camera angles.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Evaluate each take's effectiveness for storytelling, including composition, actor performance, pacing, and continuity with adjacent shots.

information_nodes.description: Directorial or editorial guidance describing the intended narrative structure, scene order, and story objectives.
Evaluate each available take within a scene to identify the most effective shots based on performance, composition, continuity, and alignment with the intended story.
Determine the ordering and combination of selected shots across scenes so that cuts are logical and the assembled sequence runs smoothly as a continuous story.

modality_hypotheses.information_needed: Visual content, framing, timing, continuity, and performance quality of each take across all scenes.
modality_hypotheses.modality_rationale: Evaluate each take's effectiveness for storytelling, including composition, actor performance, pacing, and continuity with adjacent shots.

work_objective: Select and combine the most effective shots of each scene to form a logical and smoothly running story.

deliverables.description: Concept visual deliverable: either a set of 2D concept layouts or a 3D mock-up representation of the game concept, communicating spatial composition, form, and visual direction derived from the design brief.

information_nodes.description: The request describing the game concept, subject matter, and visual intent to be represented.
Specified layout dimensions, mock-up scale, viewing conditions, or other explicit visual requirements for the concept work.
Existing visual references, style targets, or prior concept art that establish the intended look and feel.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Interpret visible spatial and stylistic relationships to carry them into the concept layout or mock-up.

information_nodes.description: Extract the visual and spatial requirements implied by the brief, specifications, and references, judging which elements must be represented and which stylistic directions to follow.
Define what visual content the concept must convey, including focal subject, environment or interface elements, and level of detail appropriate to the design stage.
Decide whether the concept is best expressed as a 2D layout or a 3D mock-up based on the design stage, content complexity, and stated requirements.
Derive the composition: spatial arrangement, perspective or elevation, scale relationships, lighting and color treatment that will communicate the concept.

modality_hypotheses.information_needed: Spatial arrangement, form language, palette, and compositional relationships shown in the reference imagery.
modality_hypotheses.modality_rationale: Interpret visible spatial and stylistic relationships to carry them into the concept layout or mock-up.

work_objective: Prepare two-dimensional concept layouts or three-dimensional mock-ups that visually communicate a game design concept to stakeholders.
